asset_policy: Original generated art. Source PNGs copied unchanged; source placement audited through metadata instead of assuming exact requested grid positions.

atlas.initial_prompt: Create an ORIGINAL production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for ATLAS, the FIRST character (upper left) in the reference. The reference is character identity ONLY; do not copy other game art. Atlas has tousled dark navy-black hair, warm tan skin, navy suit, pale-blue open-collar shirt, brown shoes, no glasses, no tie. Keep this same identity throughout. This is a technical game asset, NOT a mockup or illustration. Transparent RGBA background, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows, no furniture, no numbers. Exact canvas 1536 wide x 1024 high, exactly 6 columns x 4 rows of equal 256x256 cells. Every cell contains one full-body sprite, same scale, anchored center x=128 with soles at y=240 relative to its cell, entirely contained in that cell, plentiful transparent margin. Character should occupy about 96px wide and 180px high in each cell, crisp integer-pixel clusters with a limited palette and detailed tasteful shading, chibi proportions suited to a warm top-down pixel office. Consistent overhead three-quarter RPG camera (not isometric). FOUR directional rows in this EXACT order: row 1 facing DOWN toward camera; row 2 facing LEFT, genuine side silhouette; row 3 facing RIGHT, genuine side silhouette; row 4 facing UP away from camera, back of head and suit, no face. SIX columns in EXACT order in each row: column1 standing neutral idle; column2 walking left-foot contact; column3 walking passing pose; column4 walking right-foot contact; column5 walking opposite passing pose; column6 seated pose with bent knees and lowered hips, no chair drawn. Walking must show natural alternating arms/legs, grounded shoes and a coherent 4-frame loop. Back views must truly show the back; side views must truly show profiles. No stretched/rotated duplicate front poses. Preserve hair/clothes/palette/size exactly across all 24 frames. Prioritize a strictly complete 6-by-4 sheet and identical foot anchors so it can be directly sliced by a game engine. Do not draw a scene or multiple identities. Return only the transparent sprite sheet.
atlas.repair_prompt: EDIT this Atlas animation sheet, preserve the exact 1536x1024 canvas, 6 columns by 4 rows layout, identity, style, palette, four directional row order down/left/right/up, and idle column1 and seated column6. Correct ONLY the four walking columns 2/3/4/5, especially profile rows2 and3: they currently repeat the same leg silhouette. Make an actual clear complete four-pose gait cycle: column2 full stride with LEFT LEG forward and RIGHT LEG back (arms opposite); column3 legs passing vertically under hips, LEFT FOOT planted and RIGHT KNEE lifted, hands close to body; column4 full stride with RIGHT LEG forward and LEFT LEG back (arms opposite); column5 legs passing vertically under hips, RIGHT FOOT planted and LEFT KNEE lifted. Use shirt/sleeve shading to distinguish near/far limbs; profile passing poses must have narrower foot spacing than contact poses. For both side views show four distinct silhouettes, NOT four copies of the same open-legged frame. Preserve the feet baseline within each row and body size. Keep transparent background outside sprites, remove any diffuse glow/background remnants, no ground shadow, no objects/text/lines. Crisp pixel clusters, no new hair/clothing identities. All 24 complete sprites contained in the existing equal-sized cells. This is a game sprite sheet, no scene.
